title: Introduce credentialed intake preview and automated cost-glossary generator
author: Jae Park
release_notes: Adds an optional credentialed preview endpoint for model intake manifests and a lightweight cost-glossary generator that synthesizes per-variant cost guidance for release notes. No breaking changes to onboard contracts; opt-in feature behind flag.
body:
Context and motivation: teams asked for a lightweight way to preview what will be ingested when opening model intake requests (metadata normalization, cost hints, and privacy labels) without granting full registry write permissions. This PR adds a credentialed intake preview endpoint and a small release-note helper (cost-glossary generator) that produces concise cost and performance blurbs suitable for changelogs. The preview is credentialed (requires intake:preview scope) and returns a sanitized preview manifest plus inferred cost buckets and suggested profile tags. The cost-glossary generator takes a profile snapshot and telemetry hints (token-cost estimates, typical sequence length) and emits a short, standardized blurb for release notes so that product writers and SREs can quickly understand expected inference economics.
Design summary:
- credentialed preview service: a minimal, read-only path that performs the same normalization steps as the onboarding pipeline but never persists artifacts. It runs the onboard linter, checksum validator, and the new cost-hint annotator in a sandbox.
- cost-glossary generator: deterministic template-based generator that consumes model profile metadata and sampled telemetry (if present) and outputs 1-3 sentence guidance with token cost estimate ranges and suggested quantization/variant callouts.
- opt-in and safety: preview endpoint requires an issuance of a short-lived JWT with intake:preview scope; responses redact PII and strip any keys flagged sensitive by the onboard contract linter.
- compatibility: no changes to the canonical onboard contract; the preview is additive. The cost-glossary is a helper in the tooling layer and does not alter stored profiles.
Checklist:
- [x] Implement preview endpoint + credential check
- [x] Implement cost-glossary generator with templates and fallback heuristics
- [x] Add CLI hook (registry cli onboard preview)
- [x] Unit tests for preview signer, redaction rules, cost templates
- [x] Integration smoke test against staging intake pipeline
- [x] Docs: onboarding/preview.md and sample release note snippets
- [x] Feature flag gated and behind RBAC scope
- [x] Manual review with security & SRE (SUP-3312)
Commits summary:
- commit 1: add preview service skeleton and route handler
- commit 2: implement credential validator and short-lived JWT parsing
- commit 3: cost-hint annotator and template engine
- commit 4: CLI proxy for preview + docs
- commit 5: tests and staging smoke harness
- commit 6: fix lint (formatting) and expand redaction list
Changed files (high level):
- registry/ingest/preview_signer.py: new credential validation and redaction pipeline
- registry/ingest/preview_runner.py: the sandboxed normalization flow that mirrors onboard ingest path but never persists
- registry/onboard/cost_glossary.py: deterministic template generator + heuristics
- cli/onboard_preview.py: user-facing CLI entrypoint and examples
- docs/onboarding/preview.md: how to request preview and constraints
- tests/test_preview_signer.py: unit tests for redaction/credential checks
- tests/test_cost_glossary.py: template outputs and edge cases
- scripts/staging_smoke_preview.sh: small smoke script used in CI
- infra/feature_flags.toml: gated flag for preview rollout
Review conversation (summary):
- Aisha: initial review requested stronger guarantees around sensitive fields being removed. Asked for a small blacklist + allowlist approach.
- Jae: implemented blacklist in preview_signer and added unit tests for each redaction rule. Responded that we use the onboard linter's contract to drive allowlist where possible.
- Diego: raised concern about accidental cost estimates being interpreted as SLA numbers by customers. Requested wording changes in generator templates to emphasize "estimates" and include percentile ranges.
- Jae: updated templates to include 50th/90th estimate bands and explicit "estimate" prefix.
- Lina: asked for CI coverage for the new CLI command; found a flaky test in staging smoke.
- Jae: narrowed the smoke harness to deterministic inputs and re-ran tests.
- Security (via SUP-3312): verified that preview endpoint requires intake:preview scope and that tokens are short-lived.
CI summary:
- First run: lint failed (formatting) and one flaky integration test failure on staging smoke harness.
- Fixes: formatting commit and deterministic inputs in smoke harness.
- Final CI: all checks passed: unit, integration (staging), lint, and accessibility smoke.
Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-18 by Lina Chen.
Post-merge actions:
- Rollout plan: start with internal beta (dev teams) for 48 hours, monitor preview endpoint QPS/latency and counts of redacted keys.
- Telemetry: added metrics preview.requests, preview.redactions_total, cost_glossary.generated_total.
- Docs task: small product note and changelog snippet prepared in docs/releases/2026-02-18.md.
Security notes:
- preview responses explicitly redact fields marked sensitive in onboard contract and never include credentials or customer-provided private keys.
- Access requires an RBAC grant; default for new customers is disabled.
Backwards compatibility and migration: none required.
How to validate in staging:
- request a short-lived token via internal token service with intake:preview and run registry-cli onboard preview --manifest example.yaml.
- confirm redacted fields in response and check cost_glossary output for expected 50/90 percentile markers.
